description: Report a value that looks wrong, or a label photo that looks fake. Free. Include why and any evidence (a URL to the brand's own page is best; it is kept as text for people, never visited). Flags open review tasks. With proof_id (a photo proof, from a card's sources, e.g. "p123" is 123), the flag lands on every value that photo currently proves.

id.description: Entity id, e.g. fd_k3m9x2q8vt7w4p (food), pr_ (product), sp_ (supplement), mi_ (menu item), rc_ (recipe). A source id also works: fdc:<USDA fdcId>, ndb:<NDB number>, dsld:<DSLD id>, fndds:<food code>, lnhpd:<LNHPD id>, ciqual:<alim_code>, cnf:<food code>, cofid:<food code>, matvaretabellen:<food id>, slv:<Livsmedelsverket number>.

proof_id.description: A photo proof to flag as fake or wrong: every value it currently proves is flagged.

name: flag
